## Task Description
Read your task brief first — it is your requirements, use its exact field names/values:
`/home/zhaodan/work/PythonProjects/agent-hub/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console/task-2-brief.md`

## Scope

- SQL requirement: at most one aggregate query per table; `users` one `GROUP BY status, role`; conversations/runs/a2a_tasks/knowledge_documents/attachments each one `GROUP BY status` (attachments also SUM); messages/knowledge_chunks one COUNT each; total 8 queries. No `select(User)`/`select(Run)` + Python filtering. Use `int(... or 0)`.
- `build_overview` docstring states "精确计数，O(表大小)；管理端低频只读；表规模增大后再评估统计表，不在 M8".
- Do NOT modify docs/openapi.json or docs/*.md (T7 owns docs). Do not change other modules.

## Tests (`tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py`)
- Empty baseline: only `admin_auth` → users total=1/active=1/disabled=0/admins=1; all other leaves 0; generated_at parseable.
- Seeded counts: use direct DB inserts. Follow existing fixtures/tests for required columns (e.g. `tests/integration/test_conversations.py`, `test_chat.py`, `test_tasks.py`, `test_knowledge_models.py`, `test_attachments.py`). Brief's target numbers: 3 users (1 disabled), 4 conversations (active/active/archived/deleted), 5 messages, 6 runs (queued/running/succeeded/failed/canceled/interrupted; note `uq_runs_active_conversation` only constrains active runs), 1 RemoteAgent + 2 A2aTask (completed/failed), 2 KnowledgeDocument (ready/failed) + 3 chunks on the ready doc, 3 Attachments (ready 100, processing 200, deleted 999; user_id=user.id) → assert every number.
  If a direct insert hits an unforeseen NOT NULL/constraint, adjust the fixture minimally and document it in the report; do not weaken the assertion set.
- Bounded queries: attach a `before_cursor_execute` listener on `get_engine().sync_engine`, call the endpoint, count SELECTs ≤10 (auth + 8 aggregates + session overhead).
- 403 for normal user with `details.required_role`; 401 without token.
- TDD: write failing tests first (404 expected), then implement.

- Work from `/home/zhaodan/work/PythonProjects/agent-hub`; `.venv/bin/python`.
- Test DB must be `agent_hub_test`:
  `TEST_DATABASE_URL="$(grep '^DATABASE_URL=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | sed 's#/agent_hub$#/agent_hub_test#')" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py -v`

Only `git add` the exact files you changed (`app/modules/admin/*`, `tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py`). Never `git add -A` / `git add .`. Local commit only; no push.

Do all work yourself; never spawn a subagent or reviewer.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

# Test-Driven Development (TDD)

## Overview

Write the test first. Watch it fail. Write minimal code to pass.

**Core principle:** If you didn't watch the test fail, you don't know if it tests the right thing.

**Violating the letter of the rules is violating the spirit of the rules.**

## When to Use

**Always:**
- New features
- Bug fixes
- Refactoring
- Behavior changes

**Exceptions (ask your human partner):**
- Throwaway prototypes
- Generated code
- Configuration files

Thinking "skip TDD just this once"? Stop. That's rationalization.

## The Iron Law

```
NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST
```

Write code before the test? Delete it. Start over.

**No exceptions:**
- Don't keep it as "reference"
- Don't "adapt" it while writing tests
- Don't look at it
- Delete means delete

Implement fresh from tests. Period.

## Red-Green-Refactor

```dot
digraph tdd_cycle {
    rankdir=LR;
    red [label="RED\nWrite failing test", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ffcccc"];
    verify_red [label="Verify fails\ncorrectly", shape=diamond];
    green [label="GREEN\nMinimal code", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ccffcc"];
    verify_green [label="Verify passes\nAll green", shape=diamond];
    refactor [label="REFACTOR\nClean up", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ccccff"];
    next [label="Next", shape=ellipse];

    red -> verify_red;
    verify_red -> green [label="yes"];
    verify_red -> red [label="wrong\nfailure"];
    green -> verify_green;
    verify_green -> refactor [label="yes"];
    verify_green -> green [label="no"];
    refactor -> verify_green [label="stay\ngreen"];
    verify_green -> next;
    next -> red;
}
```

### RED - Write Failing Test

Write one minimal test showing what should happen.

<Good>
```typescript
test('retries failed operations 3 times', async () => {
  let attempts = 0;
  const operation = () => {
    attempts++;
    if (attempts < 3) throw new Error('fail');
    return 'success';
  };

  const result = await retryOperation(operation);

  expect(result).toBe('success');
  expect(attempts).toBe(3);
});
```
Clear name, tests real behavior, one thing
</Good>

<Bad>
```typescript
test('retry works', async () => {
  const mock = jest.fn()
    .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error())
    .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error())
    .mockResolvedValueOnce('success');
  await retryOperation(mock);
  expect(mock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
});
```
Vague name, tests mock not code
</Bad>

**Requirements:**
- One behavior
- Clear name
- Real code (no mocks unless unavoidable)

### Verify RED - Watch It Fail

**MANDATORY. Never skip.**

```bash
npm test path/to/test.test.ts
```

Confirm:
- Test fails (not errors)
- Failure message is expected
- Fails because feature missing (not typos)

**Test passes?** You're testing existing behavior. Fix test.

**Test errors?** Fix error, re-run until it fails correctly.

### GREEN - Minimal Code

Write simplest code to pass the test.

<Good>
```typescript
async function retryOperation<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (e) {
      if (i === 2) throw e;
    }
  }
  throw new Error('unreachable');
}
```
Just enough to pass
</Good>

<Bad>
```typescript
async function retryOperation<T>(
  fn: () => Promise<T>,
  options?: {
    maxRetries?: number;
    backoff?: 'linear' | 'exponential';
    onRetry?: (attempt: number) => void;
  }
): Promise<T> {
  // YAGNI
}
```
Over-engineered
</Bad>

Don't add features, refactor other code, or "improve" beyond the test.

### Verify GREEN - Watch It Pass

**MANDATORY.**

```bash
npm test path/to/test.test.ts
```

Confirm:
- Test passes
- Other tests still pass
- Output pristine (no errors, warnings)

**Test fails?** Fix code, not test.

**Other tests fail?** Fix now.

**"Other tests" means the project's suite, not just your file.** A
green run of the test you wrote is not a green suite. Before you call
the change done, run the project's test command (bare `pytest`,
`npm test`, `cargo test` — whatever the repo uses) even when your task
named only one test file. A scope statement in your task bounds the
deliverable, not your verification. Any failure that run shows —
including one you didn't cause — goes in your report by name; a red
test you watched scroll past and didn't mention is a report falsified
by omission.

### REFACTOR - Clean Up

After green only:
- Remove duplication
- Improve names
- Extract helpers

Keep tests green. Don't add behavior.

### Repeat

Next failing test for next feature.

## Good Tests

| Quality | Good | Bad |
|---------|------|-----|
| **Minimal** | One thing. "and" in name? Split it. | `test('validates email and domain and whitespace')` |
| **Clear** | Name describes behavior | `test('test1')` |
| **Shows intent** | Demonstrates desired API | Obscures what code should do |

When writing or changing any test, read [writing-good-tests.md](writing-good-tests.md) for the rules that keep tests honest:
- Name the production change that would make the test fail — before writing it
- Assert on real behavior, never on mock behavior
- Keep test-only code in test utilities, out of production classes
- Understand a dependency's side effects before mocking it

## Common Rationalizations

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "Too simple to test" | Simple code breaks. Test takes 30 seconds. |
| "I'll test after" | Tests written after pass immediately — which proves nothing. They may test the wrong thing, test the implementation instead of the behavior, or miss the edge case you forgot. You never watched it fail, so you never proved it can catch the bug. Test-first forces that failure. |
| "Tests after achieve same goals (spirit not ritual)" | Tests-after answer "what does this do?"; tests-first answer "what should this do?" Tests written after are biased by the code you already wrote — you verify the cases you remembered, not the ones you'd have discovered. Coverage without proof the tests work. |
| "Already manually tested" | Manual testing is ad-hoc: no record of what you covered, no way to re-run it when the code changes, easy to forget cases under pressure. "Worked when I tried it" ≠ comprehensive. Automated tests run the same way every time. |
| "Deleting X hours is wasteful" | Sunk cost fallacy — that time is already spent either way. The real choice: rewrite with TDD (high confidence) vs. keep it and bolt tests on after (low confidence, likely bugs). Keeping code you can't trust is the waste. |
| "Keep as reference, write tests first" | You'll adapt it. That's testing after. Delete means delete. |
| "Need to explore first" | Fine. Throw away exploration, start with TDD. |
| "Test hard = design unclear" | Listen to test. Hard to test = hard to use. |
| "TDD will slow me down" | TDD IS the pragmatic path: catches bugs before commit, prevents regressions, lets you refactor without fear. "Pragmatic" shortcuts mean debugging in production — slower, not faster. |
| "Manual test faster" | Manual doesn't prove edge cases. You'll re-test every change. |
| "Existing code has no tests" | You're improving it. Add tests for existing code. |

## Red Flags - STOP and Start Over

- Code before test
- Test after implementation
- Test passes immediately
- Can't explain why test failed
- Tests added "later"
- Rationalizing "just this once"
- "I already manually tested it"
- "Tests after achieve the same purpose"
- "It's about spirit not ritual"
- "Keep as reference" or "adapt existing code"
- "Already spent X hours, deleting is wasteful"
- "TDD is dogmatic, I'm being pragmatic"
- "This is different because..."

**All of these mean: Delete code. Start over with TDD.**

## Example: Bug Fix

**Bug:** Empty email accepted

**RED**
```typescript
test('rejects empty email', async () => {
  const result = await submitForm({ email: '' });
  expect(result.error).toBe('Email required');
});
```

**Verify RED**
```bash
$ npm test
FAIL: expected 'Email required', got undefined
```

**GREEN**
```typescript
function submitForm(data: FormData) {
  if (!data.email?.trim()) {
    return { error: 'Email required' };
  }
  // ...
}
```

**Verify GREEN**
```bash
$ npm test
PASS
```

**REFACTOR**
Extract validation for multiple fields if needed.

## Verification Checklist

Before marking work complete:

- [ ] Every new function/method has a test
- [ ] Watched each test fail before implementing
- [ ] Each test failed for expected reason (feature missing, not typo)
- [ ] Wrote minimal code to pass each test
- [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] Output pristine (no errors, warnings)
- [ ] Tests use real code (mocks only if unavoidable)
- [ ] Edge cases and errors covered

Can't check all boxes? You skipped TDD. Start over.

## When Stuck

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| Don't know how to test | Write wished-for API. Write assertion first. Ask your human partner. |
| Test too complicated | Design too complicated. Simplify interface. |
| Must mock everything | Code too coupled. Use dependency injection. |
| Test setup huge | Extract helpers. Still complex? Simplify design. |

## Debugging Integration

Bug found? Write failing test reproducing it. Follow TDD cycle. Test proves fix and prevents regression.

Never fix bugs without a test.

## Final Rule

```
Production code → test exists and failed first
Otherwise → not TDD
```

No exceptions without your human partner's permission.
</skill_instructions>
</skill_content>

1: # M8 管理台后端（原 X2）实施计划
2: 
3: > **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
4: 
5: **Goal:** 在不新增数据库迁移的前提下，为管理控制台交付真实契约：用户列表/详情/角色与状态管理、只读概览、平台默认指令、系统技能、系统 MCP、全局 Agent 的查询与管理，复用 M7 的 `AdminUser` 门禁、既有领域服务、统一错误信封与游标分页，并同步 OpenAPI / `docs/api.md` / 前端交接。
6: 
7: **Architecture:** 新增 `app/modules/admin/` 作为**薄 HTTP 适配层**（`router.py` / `schemas.py` / `service.py`）：只有「用户管理」与「概览」是全新业务，SQL 与规则放 `admin/service.py`；平台指令、系统技能、系统 MCP、全局 Agent 的校验、审计与生效优先级仍留在各自领域服务（`instructions` / `skills` / `mcp` / `agents`），管理路由只做参数转换与 `AdminUser` 门禁，避免复制 SSRF、`secret:` 解析、`force_disabled` 合并等易漂移逻辑。所有新端点挂在 `/api/v1/admin/*`，读接口不分页或复用不透明游标，写接口落审计；**无迁移**。
8: 
9: **Tech Stack:** FastAPI、SQLAlchemy 2.x async、Pydantic v2、pytest-asyncio、httpx、PostgreSQL（复用本机 `dev_postgres`）。不新增第三方依赖。
10: 
11: **Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-m7-m9-backend-roadmap-design.md` §4（M8 范围/验收/非目标）
12: 
13: **前置基线:** M7-2 已交付 `AdminUser` RBAC（403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"` + `security.rbac_denied` 审计）；当前迁移 head `2d8f6a1c3e70`；M7 结束时的全量测试全绿。
14: 
15: ## Global Constraints
16: 
17: - Python `>=3.13`；ruff `line-length = 100`；代码注释、docstring、API 描述、用户可见错误消息一律中文。
18: - **不新增迁移**：M8 只读写既有列，禁止修改 `app/db/models/` 与 `alembic/versions/`。已核对：
19:   `users.role/status`（M1）、`system_settings`/`user_settings`（M1）、`skills.scope/enabled/force_disabled` 与 `mcp_servers.scope/enabled/force_disabled`（M1.5）、`remote_agents.owner_user_id`（M2）、`user_capability_overrides`（M1.5）均已存在；
20:   T8 必须用 `alembic check` 证明无漂移，且 `alembic/versions/` 无新文件。
21: - 复用既有依赖/信封/分页/审计，不自造：
22:   - 路由依赖 `app.core.deps.AdminUser` / `DbSession`；403 由 M7 的 `require_admin` 统一产生；
23:   - 错误一律 `app.core.errors` 的 `DomainError` 子类 + `code` 参数；
24:   - 列表游标用 `app.core.cursor.encode_cursor/decode_cursor`，非法游标必须 422 `validation_error`；
25:   - 审计用 `app.core.audit.write_audit`，`detail` 只放长度/指纹/字段名/状态值，**不放正文、明文密钥、密文、请求头**。
26: - **管理端配置面不受能力总开关影响**（R1）：`GET/PUT /admin/settings/instruction`、`GET/PUT /admin/skills*`、`GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /admin/mcp/servers*` 在 `INSTRUCTIONS_ENABLED/SKILLS_ENABLED/MCP_ENABLED=false` 时仍可读写持久化配置；运行态接口（`/instructions`、`/skills`、`/mcp`、聊天）行为不变。
27: - 测试零网络、零外部存储、零新容器：MCP 用 `app.modules.mcp.service.register_test_transport` + `tests/helpers.make_mcp_transport`；A2A 用 `app.modules.a2a.client.register_test_transport` + `tests/fixtures/fake_a2a_agent.FakeA2aAgent`；Embedding 用 fake；数据库用 `TEST_DATABASE_URL` 指向本机已有 PostgreSQL，缺库时 skip。
28: - 不新增配置项：`Settings` 与 `.env.example` **零变更**（如实现中想加开关，先停下确认，不在 M8 私自扩）。
29: - 不修改 M7 范围（续流/RBAC/审批字段/授权 URL 白名单）；M8 只消费 M7 的 403 契约。
30: - 不实现非目标：密码重置/强制下线、多角色 RBAC、数据导出/批量操作、前端页面本身。
31: - 提交只在本地、不推送、不删分支；提交时使用**显式路径**，禁止 `git add -A`（仓库存在 `.dsh/sessions` 等运行时文件）。
32: 
33: ## Review Focus
34: 
35: 1. **最后一个活跃管理员保护**：降级/停用目标后是否仍至少剩 1 个 `role='admin' AND status='active'`；并发互相降级时用行锁串行化。测试：T1 `test_last_active_admin_is_protected`。
36: 2. **不能把自己锁死**：管理员不能修改自己的 `role`、不能停用自己的 `status`；自操作返回 422 而不是静默成功。测试：T1 `test_cannot_change_own_role` / `test_cannot_disable_self`。
37: 3. **密钥不泄露**：系统 MCP / 全局 Agent 的响应、审计、日志不得出现明文/密文/请求头值，只允许 `secret:`/`env:` 引用与 `credentials_hint`/`auth_hint`。测试：T5 `test_system_mcp_secret_ref_never_echoed`、T6 `test_admin_agent_secret_ref_and_headers_not_echoed`。
38: 4. **403 信封一致**：任何 `/admin/*` 非管理员访问都必须是 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"`，未登录 401；不能出现 404/500 或空 `details`。测试：T1 `test_non_admin_forbidden_and_unauthorized`，T2–T6 各文件各有一条 403 用例。
39: 5. **审计覆盖与不泄密**：用户改角色/状态、平台指令保存/恢复、系统技能启停/强制停用、系统 MCP 增删改、全局 Agent PATCH 都写审计，`action/resource_type/resource_id` 稳定；`detail` 不含正文与凭据。测试：T1/T3/T4/T5/T6 的 audit 断言。
40: 6. **概览不做 N+1 / 不拉行**：`GET /admin/overview` 必须用 SQL `count`/`sum` + 单次 `GROUP BY`，不得 `select(Model)` 后 Python 循环；一次请求的 SELECT 数有上界（≤10，含鉴权）。测试：T2 `test_overview_uses_bounded_queries`。精确计数在 PostgreSQL 上仍可能扫表，这是可接受的（管理端低频只读），但不接受按状态逐条查询或加载 ORM 行。
41: 
42: ## 文件结构
43: 
44: ```text
45: app/modules/admin/                 # 新增：管理台薄适配层
46: ├── __init__.py                    # 包声明
47: ├── router.py                      # 全部 /admin/* 路由（prefix="/admin", tags=["管理台"]）
48: ├── schemas.py                     # 管理台 DTO：用户/概览/平台指令/系统技能统计/请求体
49: └── service.py                     # 用户管理 + 概览（唯一新增业务 SQL）
50: 
51: app/modules/instructions/service.py  # 修改：平台默认读取/写入（复用 SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION）
52: app/modules/skills/service.py        # 修改：系统技能列表/启停/强制停用（复用 _skill_out/_effective_enabled）
53: app/modules/mcp/service.py           # 修改：系统 MCP 列表/创建/更新/删除（复用 _validate_create/normalize_headers/_check_and_sync）
54: app/modules/mcp/schemas.py           # 修改：AdminMcpServerUpdateRequest（含 enabled/force_disabled）
55: app/modules/agents/service.py        # 修改：admin_update_agent（复用 _apply_auth/_detail_with_recent）
56: app/modules/agents/schemas.py        # 修改：AdminAgentUpdateRequest（不可编辑字段显式 422）
57: app/api/v1/router.py                 # 修改：include admin_router（复用 COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES）
58: 
59: tests/integration/test_admin_users.py
60: tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py
61: tests/integration/test_admin_instructions.py
62: tests/integration/test_admin_skills.py
63: tests/integration/test_admin_mcp.py
64: tests/integration/test_admin_agents.py
65: 
66: docs/api.md                          # 修改：§1 错误码、§2.12 管理端、§7.6 分页、新增 §11 M8 状态
67: docs/openapi.json                    # 重新导出
68: docs/feedback/2026-11-11-m8-frontend-handoff.md   # 新增
69: docs/feedback/2026-11-11-m8-backend-report.md     # 新增（T8）
70: README.md / docs/roadmap.md / docs/architecture.md / docs/database.md  # 状态与口径
71: ```
72: 
73: **为什么这样拆：**
74: 
75: - 管理台 15 个端点里 11 个是「参数转换 + 调用领域服务」，单独拆 `users.py`/`mcp.py` 等只会增加文件数；集中一个 `router.py` 便于核对 `/admin/*` 的 403 与 OpenAPI tag。
76: - 系统技能/MCP/Agent 的写规则与既有用户侧写接口共享同一套校验（SSRF、`secret:`、`force_disabled` 优先级、工具发现、审计），必须放回领域服务；若放 `admin/service.py` 会复制逻辑，后续两边漂移。
77: - 用户管理与概览是管理台独有、无既有领域服务可复用，放 `admin/service.py`，与路由同包、改动内聚。
78: 
79: ## 契约总览（新端点）
80: 
81: | # | 方法/路径 | 请求要点 | 成功 | 失败码（除通用 401/403） |
82: |---|---|---|---|---|
83: | T1 | `GET /api/v1/admin/users` | `q`、`role`、`status`、`limit=20`、`cursor` | 200 `AdminUserPage` | 422 `validation_error` |
84: | T1 | `GET /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}` | 路径 UUID | 200 `AdminUserOut` | 404 `not_found` |
85: | T1 | `PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}` | `{role?, status?}`，至少一项 | 200 `AdminUserOut` | 404；422 `cannot_change_own_role` / `cannot_disable_self`；409 `last_admin_protected` |
86: | T2 | `GET /api/v1/admin/overview` | 无 | 200 `AdminOverviewOut` | — |
87: | T3 | `GET /api/v1/admin/settings/instruction` | 无 | 200 `AdminInstructionOut` | — |
88: | T3 | `PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/instruction` | `{content: str\|null}`（null=恢复内置默认） | 200 `AdminInstructionOut` | 422 `instruction_too_long` |
89: | T4 | `GET /api/v1/admin/skills` | `q` | 200 `AdminSkillListOut` | — |
90: | T4 | `PUT /api/v1/admin/skills/{skill_id}/enabled` | `{enabled: bool}` | 200 `SkillOut` | 404 `not_found` |
91: | T4 | `PUT /api/v1/admin/skills/{skill_id}/force-disable` | `{force_disabled: bool}` | 200 `SkillOut` | 404 `not_found` |
92: | T5 | `GET /api/v1/admin/mcp/servers` | 无 | 200 `McpServerListOut` | — |
93: | T5 | `POST /api/v1/admin/mcp/servers` | `McpServerCreateRequest` | 201 `McpServerOut` | 409 `conflict`；422 `mcp_ssrf_blocked` / `mcp_transport_not_allowed` / `secret_ref_*`；503 `secret_store_unavailable` |
94: | T5 | `PATCH /api/v1/admin/mcp/servers/{server_id}` | `AdminMcpServerUpdateRequest` | 200 `McpServerOut` | 404；422（同上）；503 |
95: | T5 | `DELETE /api/v1/admin/mcp/servers/{server_id}` | 无 | 204 | 404 |
96: | T6 | `GET /api/v1/admin/agents` | 同 `GET /agents`：`health_status`、`enabled`、`q`、`limit`、`cursor` | 200 `AgentPage` | 422 `validation_error` |
97: | T6 | `PATCH /api/v1/admin/agents/{agent_id}` | `AdminAgentUpdateRequest` | 200 `AgentDetailOut` | 404；422 `validation_error` |
98: 
99: > 所有端点：未登录 401 `unauthorized`；非管理员 403 `forbidden`（`details.required_role="admin"`）；预置契约 403 描述由 `COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES` 统一注入。所有端点响应头都有 `X-Request-ID`。

47: def _build_filters(
48:     q: str | None, role: str | None, status: str | None
49: ) -> list[Any]:
50:     """按 q/role/status 组装筛选条件；游标条件单独追加，不进入 stats。"""
51:     filters: list[Any] = []
52:     if q:
53:         pattern = f"%{_escape_like(q)}%"
54:         filters.append(
55:             or_(
56:                 User.email.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
57:                 User.display_name.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
58:             )
59:         )
60:     if role:
61:         filters.append(User.role == role)
62:     if status:
63:         filters.append(User.status == status)
64:     return filters

67: async def _user_stats(db: AsyncSession, filters: list[Any]) -> AdminUserStats:
68:     stmt = select(
69:         func.count(User.id).label("total"),
70:         func.count(User.id).filter(User.status == "active").label("active"),
71:         func.count(User.id).filter(User.status == "disabled").label("disabled"),
72:         func.count(User.id).filter(User.role == "admin").label("admins"),
73:     ).where(*filters)
74:     row = (await db.execute(stmt)).one()
75:     return AdminUserStats(
76:         total=int(row.total),
77:         active=int(row.active),
78:         disabled=int(row.disabled),
79:         admins=int(row.admins),
80:     )

83: def _cursor_filter(cursor: str | None) -> Any | None:
84:     """解码 ``{created_at, id}`` 游标；非法/缺字段统一 422。"""
85:     if not cursor:
86:         return None
87:     decoded = decode_cursor(cursor)
88:     raw_created_at = decoded.get("created_at")
89:     raw_id = decoded.get("id")
90:     if raw_created_at is None or raw_id is None:
91:         raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
92:     try:
93:         last_created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(str(raw_created_at))
94:         last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id))
95:     except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
96:         raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
97:     return or_(
98:         User.created_at < last_created_at,
99:         and_(
100:             User.created_at == last_created_at,
101:             User.id < last_id,
102:         ),
103:     )

106: async def list_users(

112:     limit: int,
113:     cursor: str | None,

118:     stats = await _user_stats(db, filters)
119:     page_filters = [*filters, cursor_condition] if cursor_condition is not None else filters
120: 
121:     stmt = (
122:         select(User)
123:         .where(*page_filters)
124:         .order_by(User.created_at.desc(), User.id.desc())
125:         .limit(limit + 1)
126:     )
127:     rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars())
128:     has_more = len(rows) > limit
129:     rows = rows[:limit]
130: 
131:     next_cursor = None
132:     if has_more and rows:
133:         last = rows[-1]
134:         next_cursor = encode_cursor({"created_at": last.created_at, "id": last.id})
135: 
136:     return AdminUserPage(
137:         items=[_to_out(row) for row in rows],
138:         next_cursor=next_cursor,
139:         has_more=has_more,
140:         stats=stats,
141:     )

151: async def update_user(
152:     db: AsyncSession,
153:     admin: User,
154:     user_id: uuid.UUID,
155:     payload: AdminUserPatchRequest,
156: ) -> AdminUserOut:
157:     target = await db.get(User, user_id)
158:     if target is None:
159:         raise NotFoundError("用户不存在")
160: 
161:     # 只统计实际变化的字段：同值 PATCH 是 no-op，不写审计。
162:     changed: set[str] = set()
163:     if payload.role is not None and payload.role != target.role:
164:         changed.add("role")
165:     if payload.status is not None and payload.status != target.status:
166:         changed.add("status")
167:     if not changed:
168:         return _to_out(target)
169: 
170:     # 自操作规则优先于最后管理员保护，返回 422 而不是静默成功。
171:     if target.id == admin.id and "role" in changed:
172:         raise ValidationFailedError(
173:             "不能修改自己的角色", code="cannot_change_own_role"
174:         )
175:     if target.id == admin.id and payload.status == "disabled":
176:         raise ValidationFailedError("不能停用自己的账号", code="cannot_disable_self")
177: 
178:     # 把活跃管理员降级或停用前，先按 id ASC 锁住全部活跃管理员行：固定加锁顺序
179:     # 防死锁，锁后 refresh 目标再计算剩余数量，防两个管理员并发互相降级。
180:     demote_or_disable_active_admin = (
181:         target.role == "admin"
182:         and target.status == "active"
183:         and (payload.role == "user" or payload.status == "disabled")
184:     )
185:     if demote_or_disable_active_admin:
186:         locked_ids = list(
187:             (
188:                 await db.execute(
189:                     select(User.id)
190:                     .where(User.role == "admin", User.status == "active")
191:                     .order_by(User.id)
192:                     .with_for_update()
193:                 )
194:             ).scalars()
195:         )
196:         await db.refresh(target)
197:         remaining = len(locked_ids) - (1 if target.id in locked_ids else 0)
198:         if target.role == "admin" and target.status == "active" and remaining == 0:
199:             raise ConflictError(
200:                 "不能移除最后一个活跃管理员",
201:                 code="last_admin_protected",
202:                 details={"active_admins": 1},
203:             )
204: 
205:     if payload.role is not None:
206:         target.role = payload.role
207:     if payload.status is not None:
208:         target.status = payload.status
209: 
210:     await write_audit(
211:         db,
212:         actor_type="user",
213:         actor_id=str(admin.id),
214:         action="admin.user.update",
215:         resource_type="user",
216:         resource_id=str(target.id),
217:         detail={
218:             "fields": sorted(changed),
219:             "role": target.role,
220:             "status": target.status,
221:         },
222:     )
223:     await db.commit()
224:     await db.refresh(target)
225:     return _to_out(target)

    email = email or f"user-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com"
    response = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/register",
        json={"email": email, "password": password, "display_name": "测试用户"},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    payload = response.json()
    payload["password"] = password
    return payload


def auth_headers(token: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}


async def collect_sse(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    *,
    headers: dict[str, str],
    payload: dict,
    stop_events: tuple[str, ...] = ("message.done", "error"),
) -> tuple[str | None, list[tuple[str, dict]]]:
    """读取 SSE 直到终态事件，返回 run_id 与事件列表。"""
    events: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    async with client.stream(
        "POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json=payload, headers=headers
    ) as response:
        assert response.status_code == 200, await response.aread()
        assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
        run_id = response.headers.get("X-Run-ID")
        event_name: str | None = None
        async for line in response.aiter_lines():
            if line.startswith("event:"):
                event_name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            elif line.startswith("data:") and event_name:
                data = json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1].strip())
                events.append((event_name, data))
                if event_name in stop_events:
                    return run_id, events
    return run_id, events


async def wait_for_event(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    *,
    headers: dict[str, str],
    payload: dict,
    wanted: str,
    timeout: float = 10.0,
) -> tuple[str | None, list[tuple[str, dict]], httpx.Response | None]:
    """打开 SSE 直到出现指定事件；返回已读事件与打开的连接（用于取消场景）。"""
    events: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
        async with client.stream(
            "POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json=payload, headers=headers
        ) as response:
            run_id = response.headers.get("X-Run-ID")
            event_name: str | None = None
            async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                if line.startswith("event:"):
                    event_name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif line.startswith("data:") and event_name:
                    events.append((event_name, json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1].strip())))
                    if event_name == wanted:
                        return run_id, events, response
    return run_id, events, None


async def collect_run_events_live(
    run_id: str,
    *,
    stop_on: set[str] | None = None,
    on_event=None,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    """服务层实时读取运行事件（绕过 ASGITransport 的整段缓冲）。

    ``on_event(name, data)`` 在读到每个事件后调用，可用于审批决定等中途交互；
    返回读到的事件列表（遇到 stop_on 中的事件即停止）。
    """
    from app.modules.chat.service import stream_run_events

    stop_on = stop_on or {"message.done", "error"}
    events: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
        async for frame in stream_run_events(uuid.UUID(run_id)):
            event_name: str | None = None
            for line in frame.strip().split("\n"):
                if line.startswith("event:"):
                    event_name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif line.startswith("data:") and event_name:
                    data = json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1].strip())
                    events.append((event_name, data))
                    if on_event is not None:
                        await on_event(event_name, data)
                    if event_name in stop_on:
                        return events
    return events

"""FastAPI 公共依赖：数据库会话、当前用户、管理员门禁。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Depends, Request
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.audit import write_audit
from app.core.errors import ForbiddenError, UnauthorizedError
from app.core.security import decode_token
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.db.session import get_db, get_session_factory

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False, description="Bearer access token")

DbSession = Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)]


async def get_current_user(
    credentials: Annotated[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None, Depends(_bearer)],
    db: DbSession,
) -> User:
    if credentials is None or not credentials.credentials:
        raise UnauthorizedError("请先登录")
    payload = decode_token(credentials.credentials, "access")
    user = await db.get(User, payload.user_id)
    if user is None or user.status != "active":
        raise UnauthorizedError("账号不存在或已停用")
    return user


CurrentUser = Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)]


async def _record_rbac_denied(user: User, request: Request) -> None:
    """用独立会话落管理员门禁拒绝审计；审计失败不能吞掉 403 响应。"""
    path = request.url.path
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as session:
            await write_audit(
                session,
                actor_type="user",
                actor_id=str(user.id),
                action="security.rbac_denied",
                resource_type="endpoint",
                resource_id=path[:64],
                detail={
                    "method": request.method,
                    "path": path[:500],
                    "required_role": "admin",
                },
                commit=True,
            )
    except Exception:
        # 审计失败只记录日志：权限结果必须稳定返回，不能因写日志故障变成 500。
        logger.warning(
            "RBAC 拒绝审计写入失败 path=%s actor_id=%s",
            path[:500],
            user.id,
            exc_info=True,
        )


async def require_admin(user: CurrentUser, request: Request) -> User:
    if user.role != "admin":
        await _record_rbac_denied(user, request)
        raise ForbiddenError("需要管理员权限", details={"required_role": "admin"})
    return user


AdminUser = Annotated[User, Depends(require_admin)]


def client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    """取客户端 IP；仅信任反向代理注入的 X-Forwarded-For 第一段。"""
    forwarded = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For")
    if forwarded:
        return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()[:64]
    return (request.client.host if request.client else "unknown")[:64]


def client_user_agent(request: Request) -> str:
    return request.headers.get("User-Agent", "")[:255]

def _checksum(seed: str) -> str:
    """生成 64 字符的假 checksum（与 SHA-256 同宽）。"""
    return hashlib.sha256(seed.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _embedding() -> list[float]:
    """构造一个单位向量，避免全零向量在余弦距离下无意义。"""
    vector = [0.0] * get_settings().embedding_dim
    vector[0] = 1.0
    return vector


def _document(**overrides: Any) -> KnowledgeDocument:

    }

    return KnowledgeChunk(**kwargs)


async def _column_meta(
    session: AsyncSession, table: str
) -> dict[str, tuple[str, int | None, bool]]:
    rows = (
        await session.execute(
            text(
                "SELECT column_name, udt_name, character_maximum_length, is_nullable "
                "FROM information_schema.columns "
                "WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = :table"
            ),
            {"table": table},
        )
    ).all()
    return {name: (udt, length, nullable == "YES") for name, udt, length, nullable in rows}


async def _index_defs(session: AsyncSession, table: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    rows = (
        await session.execute(
            text(
                "SELECT indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes "
                "WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = :table"
            ),
            {"table": table},
        )
    ).all()
    return dict(rows)

"""异步数据库引擎与会话工厂。

引擎懒加载，避免 import 阶段连接数据库（测试可以替换配置后首次使用）。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
    AsyncEngine,
    AsyncSession,
    async_sessionmaker,
    create_async_engine,
)

from app.core.config import get_settings

_engine: AsyncEngine | None = None
_session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] | None = None


def get_engine() -> AsyncEngine:
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        settings = get_settings()
        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "echo": settings.db_echo,
            "pool_pre_ping": settings.db_pool_pre_ping,

"""统一错误信封与领域异常。

HTTP 边界只做一件事：把 ``DomainError`` 转成
``{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}``，避免各模块自己拼响应体。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid
from contextvars import ContextVar
from typing import Any

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from sqlalchemy.exc import InterfaceError, OperationalError
from starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# 每个请求一个 ID，错误响应、日志与响应头共用。
request_id_ctx: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("request_id", default="")


def current_request_id() -> str:
    return request_id_ctx.get() or "unknown"


def request_id_from(request: Request) -> str:
    """读取当前请求 ID。

    ``contextvar`` 在正常请求链路中最快，但未处理异常会越过
    ``RequestContextMiddleware``（其 ``finally`` 已复位 contextvar）后才由最外层
    ``ServerErrorMiddleware`` 处理，此时只能从 ``request.state`` 取。
    """
    value = getattr(request.state, "request_id", "")
    return value or current_request_id()


class DomainError(Exception):
    """可预期的业务异常，必须由 HTTP 层统一转换。"""

    status_code: int = 400
    code: str = "bad_request"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        code: str | None = None,
        status_code: int | None = None,
        details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        if code is not None:
            self.code = code
        if status_code is not None:
            self.status_code = status_code
        self.details = details or {}

    def to_envelope(self, request_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        error: dict[str, Any] = {
            "code": self.code,
            "message": self.message,
            "request_id": request_id or current_request_id(),
        }
        # details 是向后兼容的扩展字段：前端契约只读 code/message/request_id，
        # 需要携带 run_id 等结构化信息时放在 details 里，避免破坏信封形状。
        if self.details:
            error["details"] = self.details
        return {"error": error}


class BadRequestError(DomainError):
    status_code = 400
    code = "bad_request"

async def test_overview_uses_bounded_queries(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    admin_auth: dict[str, str],
) -> None:
    """一次请求最多 10 条 SELECT（鉴权 + 8 条聚合 + 会话开销）。"""
    statements: list[str] = []

    def _capture(conn, cursor, statement, parameters, context, executemany):
        statements.append(statement)

    sync_engine = get_engine().sync_engine
    event.listen(sync_engine, "before_cursor_execute", _capture)
    try:
        response = await client.get("/api/v1/admin/overview", headers=admin_auth)
    finally:
        event.remove(sync_engine, "before_cursor_execute", _capture)

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    selects = [statement for statement in statements if statement.lstrip().upper().startswith("SELECT")]
    assert len(selects) <= 10, selects

    """把 ``GROUP BY status`` 的 ``(status, count)`` 行汇总成字典。

    某状态没有数据时字典里没有该键，由调用方按固定状态元组补 ``0``，保证
    响应里的状态键始终存在。
    """
    counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for status, count in rows:
        counts[status] += int(count or 0)
    return counts


async def build_overview(db: AsyncSession) -> AdminOverviewOut:
    """实时汇总管理台只读概览。

    计数口径：``users``/``conversations``/``messages``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
    ``knowledge`` 为全表原始计数（含软删/失败/终态），``conversations.deleted``
    单列；``attachments.total`` 只计 ``status != 'deleted'`` 的行，
    ``storage_bytes`` 为这些行的 ``COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)``，``deleted``
    单独计数。所有状态键始终存在，无数据时为 ``0``。

    SQL 口径：每张表最多一条聚合查询，共 8 条（``users`` 一条
    ``GROUP BY status, role``；``conversations``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
    ``knowledge_documents``/``attachments`` 各一条 ``GROUP BY status``；
    ``messages``/``knowledge_chunks`` 各一条 ``COUNT``），不加载 ORM 行、不做 N+1。

    性能口径：精确计数，O(表大小)；管理端低频只读；表规模增大后再评估统计表，
    不在 M8。
    """
    # 1) users：一条 GROUP BY status, role 同时得到 total/active/disabled/admins。
    user_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(User.status, User.role, func.count(User.id)).group_by(
                User.status, User.role
            )
        )
    ).all()
    users_by_status: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    users_by_role: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    users_total = 0
    for status, role, count in user_rows:
        value = int(count or 0)
        users_by_status[status] += value
        users_by_role[role] += value
        users_total += value

    # 2) conversations：全表 GROUP BY status，deleted 单列。
    conversation_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Conversation.status, func.count(Conversation.id)).group_by(
                    Conversation.status
                )
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 3) messages：一条 COUNT。
    messages_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(Message.id))) or 0)

    # 4) runs：全表 GROUP BY status，固定状态键由响应模型补齐。
    run_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Run.status, func.count(Run.id)).group_by(Run.status)
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 5) a2a_tasks：全表 GROUP BY state。
    a2a_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(A2aTask.state, func.count(A2aTask.id)).group_by(A2aTask.state)
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 6) knowledge_documents：全表 GROUP BY status。
    document_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(
                    KnowledgeDocument.status, func.count(KnowledgeDocument.id)
                ).group_by(KnowledgeDocument.status)
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 7) knowledge_chunks：一条 COUNT。
    chunks_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(KnowledgeChunk.id))) or 0)

    # 8) attachments：一条 GROUP BY status + SUM(size_bytes)；deleted 不计入
    # total/storage_bytes，只单独计数。
    attachment_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(
                Attachment.status,
                func.count(Attachment.id),
                func.coalesce(func.sum(Attachment.size_bytes), 0),
            ).group_by(Attachment.status)
        )
    ).all()
    attachments_total = 0
    attachments_storage_bytes = 0
    attachments_deleted = 0
    for status, count, size_bytes in attachment_rows:
        status_count = int(count or 0)
        if status == "deleted":
            attachments_deleted += status_count
            continue
        attachments_total += status_count
        attachments_storage_bytes += int(size_bytes or 0)

    return AdminOverviewOut(
        generated_at=datetime.now(UTC),
        users=AdminOverviewUsers(
            total=users_total,
            active=users_by_status.get("active", 0),
            disabled=users_by_status.get("disabled", 0),
            admins=users_by_role.get("admin", 0),
        ),
        conversations=AdminOverviewConversations(
            total=sum(conversation_counts.values()),
            active=conversation_counts.get("active", 0),
            archived=conversation_counts.get("archived", 0),
            deleted=conversation_counts.get("deleted", 0),
        ),
        messages=AdminOverviewMessages(total=messages_total),
        runs=AdminOverviewRuns(
            total=sum(run_counts.values()),
            **{status: run_counts.get(status, 0) for status in _RUN_STATUSES},
        ),
        a2a_tasks=AdminOverviewA2aTasks(
            total=sum(a2a_counts.values()),
            **{state: a2a_counts.get(state, 0) for state in A2A_TASK_STATES},
        ),
        knowledge=AdminOverviewKnowledge(
            documents=sum(document_counts.values()),
            chunks=chunks_total,
            documents_pending=document_counts.get("pending", 0),
            documents_indexing=document_counts.get("indexing", 0),
            documents_ready=document_counts.get("ready", 0),
            documents_failed=document_counts.get("failed", 0),
        ),
        attachments=AdminOverviewAttachments(
            total=attachments_total,
            storage_bytes=attachments_storage_bytes,
            deleted=attachments_deleted,
        ),
    )

    """把 ``GROUP BY status`` 的 ``(status, count)`` 行汇总成字典。

    某状态没有数据时字典里没有该键，由调用方按固定状态元组补 ``0``，保证
    响应里的状态键始终存在。
    """
    counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for status, count in rows:
        counts[status] += int(count or 0)
    return counts


async def build_overview(db: AsyncSession) -> AdminOverviewOut:
    """实时汇总管理台只读概览。

    计数口径：``users``/``conversations``/``messages``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
    ``knowledge`` 为全表原始计数（含软删/失败/终态），``conversations.deleted``
    单列；``attachments.total`` 只计 ``status != 'deleted'`` 的行，
    ``storage_bytes`` 为这些行的 ``COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)``，``deleted``
    单独计数。所有状态键始终存在，无数据时为 ``0``。

    SQL 口径：每张表最多一条聚合查询，共 8 条（``users`` 一条
    ``GROUP BY status, role``；``conversations``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
    ``knowledge_documents``/``attachments`` 各一条 ``GROUP BY status``；
    ``messages``/``knowledge_chunks`` 各一条 ``COUNT``），不加载 ORM 行、不做 N+1。

    性能口径：精确计数，O(表大小)；管理端低频只读；表规模增大后再评估统计表，
    不在 M8。
    """
    # 1) users：一条 GROUP BY status, role 同时得到 total/active/disabled/admins。
    user_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(User.status, User.role, func.count(User.id)).group_by(
                User.status, User.role
            )
        )
    ).all()
    users_by_status: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    users_by_role: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    users_total = 0
    for status, role, count in user_rows:
        value = int(count or 0)
        users_by_status[status] += value
        users_by_role[role] += value
        users_total += value

    # 2) conversations：全表 GROUP BY status，deleted 单列。
    conversation_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Conversation.status, func.count(Conversation.id)).group_by(
                    Conversation.status
                )
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 3) messages：一条 COUNT。
    messages_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(Message.id))) or 0)

    # 4) runs：全表 GROUP BY status，固定状态键由响应模型补齐。
    run_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Run.status, func.count(Run.id)).group_by(Run.status)
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 5) a2a_tasks：全表 GROUP BY state。
    a2a_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(A2aTask.state, func.count(A2aTask.id)).group_by(A2aTask.state)
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 6) knowledge_documents：全表 GROUP BY status。
    document_counts = _counts_by_status(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(
                    KnowledgeDocument.status, func.count(KnowledgeDocument.id)
                ).group_by(KnowledgeDocument.status)
            )
        ).all()
    )

    # 7) knowledge_chunks：一条 COUNT。
    chunks_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(KnowledgeChunk.id))) or 0)

    # 8) attachments：一条 GROUP BY status + SUM(size_bytes)；deleted 不计入
    # total/storage_bytes，只单独计数。
    attachment_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(
                Attachment.status,
                func.count(Attachment.id),
                func.coalesce(func.sum(Attachment.size_bytes), 0),
            ).group_by(Attachment.status)
        )
    ).all()
    attachments_total = 0
    attachments_storage_bytes = 0
    attachments_deleted = 0
    for status, count, size_bytes in attachment_rows:
        status_count = int(count or 0)
        if status == "deleted":
            attachments_deleted += status_count
            continue
        attachments_total += status_count
        attachments_storage_bytes += int(size_bytes or 0)

    return AdminOverviewOut(
        generated_at=datetime.now(UTC),
        users=AdminOverviewUsers(
            total=users_total,
            active=users_by_status.get("active", 0),
            disabled=users_by_status.get("disabled", 0),
            admins=users_by_role.get("admin", 0),
        ),
        conversations=AdminOverviewConversations(
            total=sum(conversation_counts.values()),
            active=conversation_counts.get("active", 0),
            archived=conversation_counts.get("archived", 0),
            deleted=conversation_counts.get("deleted", 0),
        ),
        messages=AdminOverviewMessages(total=messages_total),
        runs=AdminOverviewRuns(
            total=sum(run_counts.values()),
            **{status: run_counts.get(status, 0) for status in _RUN_STATUSES},
        ),
        a2a_tasks=AdminOverviewA2aTasks(
            total=sum(a2a_counts.values()),
            **{state: a2a_counts.get(state, 0) for state in A2A_TASK_STATES},
        ),
        knowledge=AdminOverviewKnowledge(
            documents=sum(document_counts.values()),
            chunks=chunks_total,
            documents_pending=document_counts.get("pending", 0),
            documents_indexing=document_counts.get("indexing", 0),
            documents_ready=document_counts.get("ready", 0),
            documents_failed=document_counts.get("failed", 0),
        ),
        attachments=AdminOverviewAttachments(
            total=attachments_total,
            storage_bytes=attachments_storage_bytes,
            deleted=attachments_deleted,
        ),
    )

+def _counts_by_status(rows: Any) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """把 ``GROUP BY status`` 的 ``(status, count)`` 行汇总成字典。
+
+    某状态没有数据时字典里没有该键，由调用方按固定状态元组补 ``0``，保证
+    响应里的状态键始终存在。
+    """
+    counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
+    for status, count in rows:
+        counts[status] += int(count or 0)
+    return counts
+
+
+async def build_overview(db: AsyncSession) -> AdminOverviewOut:
+    """实时汇总管理台只读概览。
+
+    计数口径：``users``/``conversations``/``messages``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
+    ``knowledge`` 为全表原始计数（含软删/失败/终态），``conversations.deleted``
+    单列；``attachments.total`` 只计 ``status != 'deleted'`` 的行，
+    ``storage_bytes`` 为这些行的 ``COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)``，``deleted``
+    单独计数。所有状态键始终存在，无数据时为 ``0``。
+
+    SQL 口径：每张表最多一条聚合查询，共 8 条（``users`` 一条
+    ``GROUP BY status, role``；``conversations``/``runs``/``a2a_tasks``/
+    ``knowledge_documents``/``attachments`` 各一条 ``GROUP BY status``；
+    ``messages``/``knowledge_chunks`` 各一条 ``COUNT``），不加载 ORM 行、不做 N+1。
+
+    性能口径：精确计数，O(表大小)；管理端低频只读；表规模增大后再评估统计表，
+    不在 M8。
+    """
+    # 1) users：一条 GROUP BY status, role 同时得到 total/active/disabled/admins。
+    user_rows = (
+        await db.execute(
+            select(User.status, User.role, func.count(User.id)).group_by(
+                User.status, User.role
+            )
+        )
+    ).all()
+    users_by_status: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
+    users_by_role: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
+    users_total = 0
+    for status, role, count in user_rows:
+        value = int(count or 0)
+        users_by_status[status] += value
+        users_by_role[role] += value
+        users_total += value
+
+    # 2) conversations：全表 GROUP BY status，deleted 单列。
+    conversation_counts = _counts_by_status(
+        (
+            await db.execute(
+                select(Conversation.status, func.count(Conversation.id)).group_by(
+                    Conversation.status
+                )
+            )
+        ).all()
+    )
+
+    # 3) messages：一条 COUNT。
+    messages_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(Message.id))) or 0)
+
+    # 4) runs：全表 GROUP BY status，固定状态键由响应模型补齐。
+    run_counts = _counts_by_status(
+        (
+            await db.execute(
+                select(Run.status, func.count(Run.id)).group_by(Run.status)
+            )
+        ).all()
+    )
+
+    # 5) a2a_tasks：全表 GROUP BY state。
+    a2a_counts = _counts_by_status(
+        (
+            await db.execute(
+                select(A2aTask.state, func.count(A2aTask.id)).group_by(A2aTask.state)
+            )
+        ).all()
+    )
+
+    # 6) knowledge_documents：全表 GROUP BY status。
+    document_counts = _counts_by_status(
+        (
+            await db.execute(
+                select(
+                    KnowledgeDocument.status, func.count(KnowledgeDocument.id)
+                ).group_by(KnowledgeDocument.status)
+            )
+        ).all()
+    )
+
+    # 7) knowledge_chunks：一条 COUNT。
+    chunks_total = int(await db.scalar(select(func.count(KnowledgeChunk.id))) or 0)
+
+    # 8) attachments：一条 GROUP BY status + SUM(size_bytes)；deleted 不计入
+    # total/storage_bytes，只单独计数。
+    attachment_rows = (
+        await db.execute(
+            select(
+                Attachment.status,
+                func.count(Attachment.id),
+                func.coalesce(func.sum(Attachment.size_bytes), 0),
+            ).group_by(Attachment.status)
+        )
+    ).all()
+    attachments_total = 0
+    attachments_storage_bytes = 0
+    attachments_deleted = 0
+    for status, count, size_bytes in attachment_rows:
+        status_count = int(count or 0)
+        if status == "deleted":
+            attachments_deleted += status_count
+            continue
+        attachments_total += status_count
+        attachments_storage_bytes += int(size_bytes or 0)
+
+    return AdminOverviewOut(
+        generated_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+        users=AdminOverviewUsers(

+            active=users_by_status.get("active", 0),
+            disabled=users_by_status.get("disabled", 0),
+            admins=users_by_role.get("admin", 0),
+        ),
+        conversations=AdminOverviewConversations(

+            active=conversation_counts.get("active", 0),
+            archived=conversation_counts.get("archived", 0),
+            deleted=conversation_counts.get("deleted", 0),
+        ),
+        messages=AdminOverviewMessages(total=messages_total),
+        runs=AdminOverviewRuns(
+            total=sum(run_counts.values()),
+            **{status: run_counts.get(status, 0) for status in _RUN_STATUSES},
+        ),
+        a2a_tasks=AdminOverviewA2aTasks(

+        ),

+            chunks=chunks_total,
+            documents_pending=document_counts.get("pending", 0),
+            documents_indexing=document_counts.get("indexing", 0),
+            documents_ready=document_counts.get("ready", 0),
+            documents_failed=document_counts.get("failed", 0),
+        ),
+        attachments=AdminOverviewAttachments(
+            total=attachments_total,
+            storage_bytes=attachments_storage_bytes,
+            deleted=attachments_deleted,

## 3. 端点与契约

### 3.1 `GET /api/v1/admin/users`

- 参数：`q`（`max_length=100`，`email`/`display_name` 大小写不敏感 ilike，转义 `%`/`_`/`\`）、`role`（`user|admin`）、`status`（`active|disabled`）、`limit`（1–100，默认 20）、`cursor`（`max_length=500`）。
- 排序：`created_at DESC, id DESC`；`limit+1` 判断 `has_more`。
- 游标：payload `{"created_at": <datetime ISO>, "id": <UUID>}`；解码失败、字段缺失、时间/UUID 非法 → 422 `validation_error`（"分页游标无效"）。
- `stats`：当前 `q/role/status` 筛选条件下的全量计数（不含游标），一次聚合查询：
  `total` / `active` / `disabled` / `admins`（`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ...)`）。
- 响应：`AdminUserPage{items, next_cursor, has_more, stats}`；`items` 与详情同形。

### 3.2 `GET /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}`

- 200 `AdminUserOut`：`id/email/display_name/role/status/last_login_at/created_at/updated_at`；**永远不含 `password_hash`**。
- 不存在 → 404 `not_found`（"用户不存在"）。
- 不带活动计数（R6）。

### 3.3 `PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}`

- 请求体 `{role?, status?}`：`extra="forbid"`、至少一项非 None，否则 422 `validation_error`。
- 规则执行顺序（`service.update_user`）：
  1. 目标不存在 → 404 `not_found`；
  2. 计算实际变化字段；无变化 → 200 返回当前值、**不写审计、不提交**；
  3. 改自己角色 → 422 `cannot_change_own_role`（"不能修改自己的角色"）；
  4. 停用自己 → 422 `cannot_disable_self`（"不能停用自己的账号"）；
  5. 把「活跃管理员」降为 `user` 或停用前，执行 `SELECT id FROM users WHERE role='admin' AND status='active' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE`，随后 `db.refresh(target)`，按锁后结果与 `remaining = len(locked_ids) - (1 if target.id in locked_ids else 0)` 判定；目标仍是活跃管理员且 `remaining == 0` → 409 `last_admin_protected`（"不能移除最后一个活跃管理员"，`details={"active_admins": 1}`）；
  6. 应用变更，`write_audit(actor_type="user", actor_id=str(admin.id), action="admin.user.update", resource_type="user", resource_id=str(target.id), detail={"fields": sorted(changed), "role": target.role, "status": target.status})`，`await db.commit()`、`await db.refresh(target)` 后返回 `AdminUserOut`。
- 固定 `id ASC` 加锁顺序防死锁；行锁 + 锁后 refresh 防两个管理员并发互降。

### 3.4 权限

- 3 个端点均使用 `AdminUser` + `DbSession`：未登录 401 `unauthorized`；非管理员 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"`（M7 `require_admin` 统一产生并写 `security.rbac_denied` 审计）。
- OpenAPI 通过 `COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES` 注入 400/401/403/404/409/413/422/429/500/503 描述。

{"content": "# M8 Task 2 交付报告：只读概览 `GET /api/v1/admin/overview`

- 日期：2026-11-11
- 任务：`.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console/task-2-brief.md`
- 计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console.md` §Global Constraints / §Review Focus（第 4、6 条）/ Task 2
- 结论：**完成**。`GET /api/v1/admin/overview` 按 brief 的字段名与口径落地，4 条新集成测试全绿；全量回归 774 passed / 1 skipped（基线 770 + 新增 4）；ruff 全绿；无迁移、未改文档、未改其他模块。
- 提交：`95412e4 feat: 管理台只读概览 GET /admin/overview（M8 Task 2）`（仅本地，未推送）

## 1. 变更文件（提交内容，共 4 文件 +608/−6 行）

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `app/modules/admin/schemas.py` | 新增 `AdminOverviewOut` 及 7 个子 DTO（users/conversations/messages/runs/a2a_tasks/knowledge/attachments）；`AdminOverviewOut` docstring 写明计数与性能口径 |
| `app/modules/admin/service.py` | 新增 `build_overview` 与 `_counts_by_status` 辅助函数；8 条聚合查询、无 ORM 行加载 |
| `app/modules/admin/router.py` | 追加 `GET /overview`，`response_model=AdminOverviewOut`，依赖 `AdminUser` + `DbSession`；无 query 参数、无审计 |
| `tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py` | 新增 4 条集成测试：空库基线、落库全量计数、SELECT 上界、403/401 |

未修改：`app/db/models/`、`alembic/versions/`（**无迁移**）、`docs/`、`docs/openapi.json`、`app/api/v1/router.py`（T1 已挂载 admin 路由）、其他业务模块。文档与 OpenAPI 导出统一由 T7 处理。

## 2. 端点契约

### 2.1 `GET /api/v1/admin/overview`

- 鉴权：`AdminUser`（`app.core.deps.require_admin`）；未登录 401 `unauthorized`，非管理员 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"`。
- 无 query 参数（OpenAPI `parameters: []` 已冒烟确认），200，`response_model=AdminOverviewOut`。
- **不写审计**：路由与 `build_overview` 均无 `write_audit` 调用；只有 M7 RBAC 拒绝路径（403）会写 `security.rbac_denied`。
- 响应字段与 brief 完全一致：

```text
generated_at
users{total,active,disabled,admins}
conversations{total,active,archived,deleted}
messages{total}
runs{total,queued,running,succeeded,failed,canceled,interrupted}
a2a_tasks{total,submitted,working,input_required,auth_required,completed,failed,canceled,rejected}
knowledge{documents,chunks,documents_pending,documents_indexing,documents_ready,documents_failed}
attachments{total,storage_bytes,deleted}
```

- `generated_at = datetime.now(UTC)`；Pydantic v2 序列化为带 `Z` 的 UTC 时间（如 `2026-11-11T14:25:00.123456Z`），可被 `datetime.fromisoformat` 解析。

### 2.2 计数口径

- `users`/`conversations`/`messages`/`runs`/`a2a_tasks`/`knowledge`：**全表原始计数**，含软删、失败、终态行。
- `users.admins`：统计 `role='admin'` 的**所有状态**行（与 T1 `_user_stats` 口径一致；停用管理员也计入）。
- `conversations.deleted`：`status='deleted'` 单列，同时仍计入 `conversations.total`。
- `attachments.total`：`status != 'deleted'` 的行数（含 `processing`/`failed` 等未删除状态）。
- `attachments.storage_bytes`：上述未删除行的 `COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)`；`deleted` 行的字节数不计入。
- 所有状态键由 Pydantic 模型的必填字段保证**始终存在**，无数据时为 `0`；聚合结果用 `_counts_by_status` 汇总，缺键取 `0`。
- 每处计数均做 `int(count or 0)`，避免 `None` 进入响应。

## 3. TDD 证据

### 3.1 RED（先写测试，路由尚不存在）

```text
$ TEST_DATABASE_URL="$(grep '^DATABASE_URL=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | sed 's#/agent_hub$#/agent_hub_test#')" \
    .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py -v

FAILED test_overview_empty_counts_are_zero
FAILED test_overview_counts_match_seeded_rows
FAILED test_overview_uses_bounded_queries
FAILED test_overview_requires_admin
============================== 4 failed in 1.67s ==============================
```

失败原因均为预期中的 404：`{"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"Not Found",...}}`，即端点缺失，不是测试代码本身报错/收集错误。

### 3.2 GREEN（实现后）

```text
$ TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py -v
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_empty_counts_are_zero PASSED
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_counts_match_seeded_rows PASSED
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_uses_bounded_queries PASSED
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_requires_admin PASSED
============================== 4 passed in 1.40s ===============================
```

实现后回归 T1 用例，确认没有破坏既有管理台用户端点：

```text
$ TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
    tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py tests/integration/test_admin_users.py -q
14 passed in 5.13s
```

## 4. SQL 设计与查询数证据

`build_overview` 共执行 **8 条聚合查询**，每张表最多一条：

1. `users`：`SELECT status, role, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status, role`
2. `conversations`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status`
3. `messages`：`SELECT COUNT(id) ...`（一条 COUNT）
4. `runs`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status`
5. `a2a_tasks`：`SELECT state, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY state`
6. `knowledge_documents`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status`
7. `knowledge_chunks`：`SELECT COUNT(id) ...`（一条 COUNT）
8. `attachments`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id), COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) ... GROUP BY status`

没有 `select(User)`/`select(Run)` 后 Python 过滤，没有按状态逐条查询，也没有缓存。

**一次请求实测 SELECT 数 = 9**：鉴权 `db.get(User)` 1 条 + 8 条聚合。为测量在测试中临时加过 `print` 探针，输出：

```text
MEASURED_SELECTS=9
1 passed in 0.50s
```

探针已在提交前删除；最终测试保留 brief 要求的 `before_cursor_execute` 监听与 `len(selects) <= 10` 断言：

```python
sync_engine = get_engine().sync_engine
event.listen(sync_engine, "before_cursor_execute", _capture)
try:
    response = await client.get("/api/v1/admin/overview", headers=admin_auth)
finally:
    event.remove(sync_engine, "before_cursor_execute", _capture)
selects = [s for s in statements if s.lstrip().upper().startswith("SELECT")]
assert len(selects) <= 10, selects
```

## 5. 测试覆盖（4 条）

| 用例 | 覆盖点 |
|---|---|
| `test_overview_empty_counts_are_zero` | 只创建 `admin_auth` 的管理员：`users={total:1,active:1,disabled:0,admins:1}`；其余 6 组叶子字段全部为 0；顶层字段集合精确匹配；`generated_at` 可解析且时区为 UTC |
| `test_overview_counts_match_seeded_rows` | 直接落库 brief 目标数据集，逐项断言全部数字（见 §6）；覆盖软删会话/软删附件、失败文档、失败/取消/中断 run 仍计入全表计数 |
| `test_overview_uses_bounded_queries` | `before_cursor_execute` 统计本次请求 SELECT，断言 ≤10；实测 9 |
| `test_overview_requires_admin` | 普通用户 403 `forbidden` + `details={"required_role":"admin"}`；无 token 401 `unauthorized` |

## 6. 落库数据与断言细节

测试 `_seed_overview_rows` 全部使用**直接 DB 插入**（未走 HTTP），测试库为 `agent_hub_test`：

| 表 | 落库行 | 期望计数 |
|---|---|---|
| `users` | 夹具 `admin`（admin/active）+ 夹具 `user`（user/active）+ 新增停用用户（user/disabled） | `total=3, active=2, disabled=1, admins=1` |
| `conversations` | 2 × active、1 × archived、1 × deleted | `total=4, active=2, archived=1, deleted=1` |
| `messages` | 活跃会话一 2 条、活跃会话二 1 条、归档会话 1 条、已删会话 1 条 | `total=5` |
| `runs` | queued（会话一）、running（会话二）、interrupted（归档会话）、succeeded/failed/canceled（已删会话） | `total=6`，6 个状态各 1 |
| `remote_agents` | 1 个 `RemoteAgent`（slug 唯一、url 为 a2a.test） | 不直接返回，仅作为 A2A 任务外键 |
| `a2a_tasks` | completed、failed 各 1，均指向上述 RemoteAgent | `total=2, completed=1, failed=1`，其余 6 状态 0 |
| `knowledge_documents` | ready 1、failed 1 | `documents=2, documents_ready=1, documents_failed=1`，pending/indexing=0 |
| `knowledge_chunks` | ready 文档下 3 个 chunk（`chunk_index=0..2`、`embedding=[0.0]*settings.embedding_dim`、checksum 文档唯一） | `chunks=3` |
| `attachments` | ready 100、processing 200、deleted 999，均 `user_id=user.id` | `total=2, storage_bytes=300, deleted=1` |

- 直接插入未触发任何未预见的 NOT NULL/CHECK/唯一约束，**没有调整/弱化夹具或断言**。
- `uq_runs_active_conversation` 只约束 active run（queued/running/interrupted），三个活跃 run 分别占用不同会话；三个终态 run 复用已删会话，插入成功。
- 零向量 `[0.0]*embedding_dim` 可正常写入 pgvector，HNSW 索引未阻止插入。
- 断言均使用完整 dict 相等（如 `body["users"] == {...}`），而不是只挑字段，确保字段集合与数值同时被冻结。

## 7. 验证结果

| 检查 | 命令 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 目标测试 | `TEST_DATABASE_URL=... pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py -q` | `4 passed in 1.40s` |
| T1 回归 | `... pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py tests/integration/test_admin_users.py -q` | `14 passed in 5.13s` |
| 全量回归 | `TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` | **`774 passed, 1 skipped in 125.52s`**（基线 770 passed + 新增 4；1 skipped 为既有 skip） |
| Lint | `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check .` | `All checks passed!` |
| OpenAPI 冒烟 | `app.openapi()` | `/api/v1/admin/overview` 的 `parameters=[]`，200 schema 指向 `AdminOverviewOut`，8 个顶层字段均为 required；403 描述由 `COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES` 注入 |
| 迁移 | — | 未新增/修改 `alembic/versions/`，未改模型 |

## 8. 自审

- **字段名/值**：`AdminOverviewOut` 的 8 个顶层字段、`users`/`conversations`/`runs`/`a2a_tasks`/`knowledge`/`attachments` 子字段与 brief 一字不差；A2A 状态使用模型导出的 `A2A_TASK_STATES`（8 个）作为键。
- **口径**：全表原始计数；`conversations.deleted` 单列；附件 `total`/`storage_bytes` 只计 `status != 'deleted'`，`deleted` 单独计数；所有状态键必填、缺省 0。
- **SQL 要求**：8 条聚合、每表最多一条；`users` 一条 `GROUP BY status, role`；`attachments` 一条查询内同时 `COUNT` + `SUM`；无 ORM 行加载、无 N+1、无 Python 过滤状态行。
- **性能口径**：`AdminOverviewOut` 与 `build_overview` 的 docstring 均写明「精确计数，O(表大小)；管理端低频只读；表规模增大后再评估统计表，不在 M8」。
- **权限**：复用 `AdminUser`，未重复实现 RBAC；403/401 信封由 M7 统一产生并有集成测试。
- **副作用**：端点无 query 参数、无审计、无缓存；未改 `Settings`、`.env.example`、模型、迁移、文档、OpenAPI 或其他模块。
- **中文规范**：新增 docstring/注释/路由 summary/description 均为中文；ruff line-length 100 通过。

## 9. 关注点 / 边界

1. **全表精确计数的成本**：8 条聚合在 PostgreSQL 上仍可能扫表，属于计划明确接受的管理端低频只读开销；本任务不引入统计表/缓存，符合「不在 M8」的约束。
2. **SELECT 上界余量**：实测 9（鉴权 1 + 聚合 8），距测试上界 10 仅 1 条余量。若未来在请求级新增会话查询或中间件查询，`test_overview_uses_bounded_queries` 会先报警；这符合 brief 的守门意图。
3. **`users.admins` 口径**：按 `role='admin'` 统计所有状态，停用管理员也计入，与 T1 `stats.admins` 一致；T7 写 `docs/api.md` 时应明确。
4. **附件口径**：`attachments.total` 包含 `processing`/`failed` 等非删除状态，只排除 `deleted`；`storage_bytes` 同样排除 deleted 行的字节。与 brief 一致，T7 文档需同步。
5. **无审计的验证方式**：本任务没有为「GET 不写审计」单独加用例，靠代码路径自审（无 `write_audit` 调用）与 403 用例的 RBAC 审计行为区分；如审查要求可补一条 `audit_logs` 计数断言。
6. **测试文件未在提交前跑单测之外的时区依赖**：`generated_at` 断言只要求可解析且 UTC，不断言与 `now` 的差值，避免系统时钟回退造成偶发失败。
7. **报告未提交**：按提交规则只 `git add` 了 `app/modules/admin/*` 与 `tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py`；本报告位于 `.superpowers/`，保持未纳入版本控制。

## 10. 待 T7 同步的文档点

1. `docs/api.md` §2.12：新增 `GET /api/v1/admin/overview`，无参数，200 `AdminOverviewOut`，401/403 信封；写明全表原始计数、`conversations.deleted` 单列、附件排除 deleted、状态键始终为 0。

- 任务：`.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console/task-2-brief.md`

- 提交：`95412e4 feat: 管理台只读概览 GET /admin/overview（M8 Task 2）`（仅本地，未推送）

## 1. 变更文件（提交内容，共 4 文件 +608/−6 行）

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `app/modules/admin/schemas.py` | 新增 `AdminOverviewOut` 及 7 个子 DTO（users/conversations/messages/runs/a2a_tasks/knowledge/attachments）；`AdminOverviewOut` docstring 写明计数与性能口径 |
| `app/modules/admin/service.py` | 新增 `build_overview` 与 `_counts_by_status` 辅助函数；8 条聚合查询、无 ORM 行加载 |
| `app/modules/admin/router.py` | 追加 `GET /overview`，`response_model=AdminOverviewOut`，依赖 `AdminUser` + `DbSession`；无 query 参数、无审计 |
| `tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py` | 新增 4 条集成测试：空库基线、落库全量计数、SELECT 上界、403/401 |

未修改：`app/db/models/`、`alembic/versions/`（**无迁移**）、`docs/`、`docs/openapi.json`、`app/api/v1/router.py`（T1 已挂载 admin 路由）、其他业务模块。文档与 OpenAPI 导出统一由 T7 处理。

## 2. 端点契约

### 2.1 `GET /api/v1/admin/overview`

- 鉴权：`AdminUser`（`app.core.deps.require_admin`）；未登录 401 `unauthorized`，非管理员 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"`。
- 无 query 参数（OpenAPI `parameters: []` 已冒烟确认），200，`response_model=AdminOverviewOut`。
- **不写审计**：路由与 `build_overview` 均无 `write_audit` 调用；只有 M7 RBAC 拒绝路径（403）会写 `security.rbac_denied`。
- 响应字段与 brief 完全一致：

```text
generated_at
users{total,active,disabled,admins}
conversations{total,active,archived,deleted}
messages{total}
runs{total,queued,running,succeeded,failed,canceled,interrupted}
a2a_tasks{total,submitted,working,input_required,auth_required,completed,failed,canceled,rejected}
knowledge{documents,chunks,documents_pending,documents_indexing,documents_ready,documents_failed}
attachments{total,storage_bytes,deleted}
```

- `generated_at = datetime.now(UTC)`；Pydantic v2 序列化为带 `Z` 的 UTC 时间（如 `2026-11-11T14:25:00.123456Z`），可被 `datetime.fromisoformat` 解析。

### 2.2 计数口径

- `users`/`conversations`/`messages`/`runs`/`a2a_tasks`/`knowledge`：**全表原始计数**，含软删、失败、终态行。
- `users.admins`：统计 `role='admin'` 的**所有状态**行（与 T1 `_user_stats` 口径一致；停用管理员也计入）。
- `conversations.deleted`：`status='deleted'` 单列，同时仍计入 `conversations.total`。
- `attachments.total`：`status != 'deleted'` 的行数（含 `processing`/`failed` 等未删除状态）。
- `attachments.storage_bytes`：上述未删除行的 `COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)`；`deleted` 行的字节数不计入。
- 所有状态键由 Pydantic 模型的必填字段保证**始终存在**，无数据时为 `0`；聚合结果用 `_counts_by_status` 汇总，缺键取 `0`。
- 每处计数均做 `int(count or 0)`，避免 `None` 进入响应。

## 3. TDD 证据

### 3.1 RED（先写测试，路由尚不存在）

```text
$ TEST_DATABASE_URL="$(grep '^DATABASE_URL=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | sed 's#/agent_hub$#/agent_hub_test#')" \
    .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py -v

FAILED test_overview_empty_counts_are_zero
FAILED test_overview_counts_match_seeded_rows
FAILED test_overview_uses_bounded_queries
FAILED test_overview_requires_admin
============================== 4 failed in 1.67s ==============================
```

失败原因均为预期中的 404：`{"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"Not Found",...}}`，即端点缺失，不是测试代码本身报错/收集错误。

### 3.2 GREEN（实现后）

```text
$ TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py -v
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_empty_counts_are_zero PASSED
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_counts_match_seeded_rows PASSED
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_uses_bounded_queries PASSED
tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py::test_overview_requires_admin PASSED
============================== 4 passed in 1.40s ===============================
```

实现后回归 T1 用例，确认没有破坏既有管理台用户端点：

```text
$ TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
    tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py tests/integration/test_admin_users.py -q
14 passed in 5.13s
```

## 4. SQL 设计与查询数证据

`build_overview` 共执行 **8 条聚合查询**，每张表最多一条：

1. `users`：`SELECT status, role, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status, role`
2. `conversations`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status`
3. `messages`：`SELECT COUNT(id) ...`（一条 COUNT）
4. `runs`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status`
5. `a2a_tasks`：`SELECT state, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY state`
6. `knowledge_documents`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id) ... GROUP BY status`
7. `knowledge_chunks`：`SELECT COUNT(id) ...`（一条 COUNT）
8. `attachments`：`SELECT status, COUNT(id), COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) ... GROUP BY status`

没有 `select(User)`/`select(Run)` 后 Python 过滤，没有按状态逐条查询，也没有缓存。

**一次请求实测 SELECT 数 = 9**：鉴权 `db.get(User)` 1 条 + 8 条聚合。为测量在测试中临时加过 `print` 探针，输出：

```text
MEASURED_SELECTS=9
1 passed in 0.50s
```

探针已在提交前删除；最终测试保留 brief 要求的 `before_cursor_execute` 监听与 `len(selects) <= 10` 断言：

```python
sync_engine = get_engine().sync_engine
event.listen(sync_engine, "before_cursor_execute", _capture)
try:
    response = await client.get("/api/v1/admin/overview", headers=admin_auth)
finally:
    event.remove(sync_engine, "before_cursor_execute", _capture)
selects = [s for s in statements if s.lstrip().upper().startswith("SELECT")]
assert len(selects) <= 10, selects
```

## 5. 测试覆盖（4 条）

| 用例 | 覆盖点 |
|---|---|
| `test_overview_empty_counts_are_zero` | 只创建 `admin_auth` 的管理员：`users={total:1,active:1,disabled:0,admins:1}`；其余 6 组叶子字段全部为 0；顶层字段集合精确匹配；`generated_at` 可解析且时区为 UTC |
| `test_overview_counts_match_seeded_rows` | 直接落库 brief 目标数据集，逐项断言全部数字（见 §6）；覆盖软删会话/软删附件、失败文档、失败/取消/中断 run 仍计入全表计数 |
| `test_overview_uses_bounded_queries` | `before_cursor_execute` 统计本次请求 SELECT，断言 ≤10；实测 9 |
| `test_overview_requires_admin` | 普通用户 403 `forbidden` + `details={"required_role":"admin"}`；无 token 401 `unauthorized` |

## 6. 落库数据与断言细节

测试 `_seed_overview_rows` 全部使用**直接 DB 插入**（未走 HTTP），测试库为 `agent_hub_test`：

| 表 | 落库行 | 期望计数 |
|---|---|---|
| `users` | 夹具 `admin`（admin/active）+ 夹具 `user`（user/active）+ 新增停用用户（user/disabled） | `total=3, active=2, disabled=1, admins=1` |
| `conversations` | 2 × active、1 × archived、1 × deleted | `total=4, active=2, archived=1, deleted=1` |
| `messages` | 活跃会话一 2 条、活跃会话二 1 条、归档会话 1 条、已删会话 1 条 | `total=5` |
| `runs` | queued（会话一）、running（会话二）、interrupted（归档会话）、succeeded/failed/canceled（已删会话） | `total=6`，6 个状态各 1 |
| `remote_agents` | 1 个 `RemoteAgent`（slug 唯一、url 为 a2a.test） | 不直接返回，仅作为 A2A 任务外键 |
| `a2a_tasks` | completed、failed 各 1，均指向上述 RemoteAgent | `total=2, completed=1, failed=1`，其余 6 状态 0 |
| `knowledge_documents` | ready 1、failed 1 | `documents=2, documents_ready=1, documents_failed=1`，pending/indexing=0 |
| `knowledge_chunks` | ready 文档下 3 个 chunk（`chunk_index=0..2`、`embedding=[0.0]*settings.embedding_dim`、checksum 文档唯一） | `chunks=3` |
| `attachments` | ready 100、processing 200、deleted 999，均 `user_id=user.id` | `total=2, storage_bytes=300, deleted=1` |

- 直接插入未触发任何未预见的 NOT NULL/CHECK/唯一约束，**没有调整/弱化夹具或断言**。
- `uq_runs_active_conversation` 只约束 active run（queued/running/interrupted），三个活跃 run 分别占用不同会话；三个终态 run 复用已删会话，插入成功。
- 零向量 `[0.0]*embedding_dim` 可正常写入 pgvector，HNSW 索引未阻止插入。
- 断言均使用完整 dict 相等（如 `body["users"] == {...}`），而不是只挑字段，确保字段集合与数值同时被冻结。

## 7. 验证结果

| 检查 | 命令 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 目标测试 | `TEST_DATABASE_URL=... pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py -q` | `4 passed in 1.40s` |
| T1 回归 | `... pytest tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py tests/integration/test_admin_users.py -q` | `14 passed in 5.13s` |
| 全量回归 | `TEST_DATABASE_URL=... .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` | **`774 passed, 1 skipped in 125.52s`**（基线 770 passed + 新增 4；1 skipped 为既有 skip） |
| Lint | `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check .` | `All checks passed!` |
| OpenAPI 冒烟 | `app.openapi()` | `/api/v1/admin/overview` 的 `parameters=[]`，200 schema 指向 `AdminOverviewOut`，8 个顶层字段均为 required；403 描述由 `COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES` 注入 |
| 迁移 | — | 未新增/修改 `alembic/versions/`，未改模型 |

## 8. 自审

- **字段名/值**：`AdminOverviewOut` 的 8 个顶层字段、`users`/`conversations`/`runs`/`a2a_tasks`/`knowledge`/`attachments` 子字段与 brief 一字不差；A2A 状态使用模型导出的 `A2A_TASK_STATES`（8 个）作为键。
- **口径**：全表原始计数；`conversations.deleted` 单列；附件 `total`/`storage_bytes` 只计 `status != 'deleted'`，`deleted` 单独计数；所有状态键必填、缺省 0。
- **SQL 要求**：8 条聚合、每表最多一条；`users` 一条 `GROUP BY status, role`；`attachments` 一条查询内同时 `COUNT` + `SUM`；无 ORM 行加载、无 N+1、无 Python 过滤状态行。
- **性能口径**：`AdminOverviewOut` 与 `build_overview` 的 docstring 均写明「精确计数，O(表大小)；管理端低频只读；表规模增大后再评估统计表，不在 M8」。
- **权限**：复用 `AdminUser`，未重复实现 RBAC；403/401 信封由 M7 统一产生并有集成测试。
- **副作用**：端点无 query 参数、无审计、无缓存；未改 `Settings`、`.env.example`、模型、迁移、文档、OpenAPI 或其他模块。
- **中文规范**：新增 docstring/注释/路由 summary/description 均为中文；ruff line-length 100 通过。

## 9. 关注点 / 边界

1. **全表精确计数的成本**：8 条聚合在 PostgreSQL 上仍可能扫表，属于计划明确接受的管理端低频只读开销；本任务不引入统计表/缓存，符合「不在 M8」的约束。
2. **SELECT 上界余量**：实测 9（鉴权 1 + 聚合 8），距测试上界 10 仅 1 条余量。若未来在请求级新增会话查询或中间件查询，`test_overview_uses_bounded_queries` 会先报警；这符合 brief 的守门意图。
3. **`users.admins` 口径**：按 `role='admin'` 统计所有状态，停用管理员也计入，与 T1 `stats.admins` 一致；T7 写 `docs/api.md` 时应明确。
4. **附件口径**：`attachments.total` 包含 `processing`/`failed` 等非删除状态，只排除 `deleted`；`storage_bytes` 同样排除 deleted 行的字节。与 brief 一致，T7 文档需同步。
5. **无审计的验证方式**：本任务没有为「GET 不写审计」单独加用例，靠代码路径自审（无 `write_audit` 调用）与 403 用例的 RBAC 审计行为区分；如审查要求可补一条 `audit_logs` 计数断言。
6. **测试文件未在提交前跑单测之外的时区依赖**：`generated_at` 断言只要求可解析且 UTC，不断言与 `now` 的差值，避免系统时钟回退造成偶发失败。
7. **报告未提交**：按提交规则只 `git add` 了 `app/modules/admin/*` 与 `tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py`；本报告位于 `.superpowers/`，保持未纳入版本控制。

## 10. 待 T7 同步的文档点

1. `docs/api.md` §2.12：新增 `GET /api/v1/admin/overview`，无参数，200 `AdminOverviewOut`，401/403 信封；写明全表原始计数、`conversations.deleted` 单列、附件排除 deleted、状态键始终为 0。
2. `docs/openapi.json` 由 T7 统一重新导出（本任务未导出，避免并行抢文件）。
3. 前端 handoff：`generated_at` 为 UTC（`Z` 后缀）；`runs.canceled` 为单 L 拼写；`a2a_tasks` 的 8 个状态键与模型枚举一致；概览计数是实时全表值，不是筛选值。

runs{total,queued,running,succeeded,failed,canceled,interrupted}
a2a_tasks{total,submitted,working,input_required,auth_required,completed,failed,canceled,rejected}
knowledge{documents,chunks,documents_pending,documents_indexing,documents_ready,documents_failed}
attachments{total,storage_bytes,deleted}
```

### 2.2 计数口径

- `users`/`conversations`/`messages`/`runs`/`a2a_tasks`/`knowledge`：**全表原始计数**，含软删、失败、终态行。
- `users.admins`：统计 `role='admin'` 的**所有状态**行（与 T1 `_user_stats` 口径一致；停用管理员也计入）。
- `conversations.deleted`：`status='deleted'` 单列，同时仍计入 `conversations.total`。
- `attachments.total`：`status != 'deleted'` 的行数（含 `processing`/`failed` 等未删除状态）。
- `attachments.storage_bytes`：上述未删除行的 `COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)`；`deleted` 行的字节数不计入。
- 所有状态键由 Pydantic 模型的必填字段保证**始终存在**，无数据时为 `0`；聚合结果用 `_counts_by_status` 汇总，缺键取 `0`。

# Verification Before Completion

## Overview

**Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.

**Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**

## The Iron Law

```
NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
```

If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.

## The Gate Function

```
BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:

1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
   - If NO: State actual status with evidence
   - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim

Skip any step = lying, not verifying
```

## Common Failures

| Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
| Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
| Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
| Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
| Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
| Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
| Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |

## Red Flags - STOP

- Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
- Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
- About to commit/push/PR without verification
- Trusting agent success reports
- Relying on partial verification
- Thinking "just this once"
- Tired and wanting work over
- **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**

## Rationalization Prevention

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
| "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
| "Just this once" | No exceptions |
| "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
| "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
| "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
| "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
| "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |

## Key Patterns

**Tests:**
```
✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
```

**Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
```
✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
```

**Build:**
```
✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
❌ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
```

**Requirements:**
```
✅ Re-read plan → Create checklist → Verify each → Report gaps or completion
❌ "Tests pass, phase complete"
```

**Agent delegation:**
```
✅ Agent reports success → Check VCS diff → Verify changes → Report actual state
❌ Trust agent report
```

## When To Apply

**ALWAYS before:**
- ANY variation of success/completion claims
- ANY expression of satisfaction
- ANY positive statement about work state
- Committing, PR creation, task completion
- Moving to next task
- Delegating to agents

**Rule applies to:**
- Exact phrases
- Paraphrases and synonyms
- Implications of success
- ANY communication suggesting completion/correctness
